About Us & Photo Gallery

Powering Jammu & Kashmir Since 1995

Jammu and Kashmir State Power Development Corporation Limited (JKSPDCL) is a wholly owned Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) of the Government of Jammu & Kashmir, incorporated in 1995 under the Companies Act to spearhead the generation and distribution of clean power.

With an authorised share capital of Rs. 5,000 crores, JKSPDCL has strategic equity investments of Rs. 2,357.61 crores in joint ventures with NHPC — including CVPPPL and RHPCL — systematically unlocking the vast hydroelectric potential across the Chenab, Jhelum, and Ravi basins.
